niche: AI systems that help real estate agencies work faster and simpler: instant lead replies, lead qualification, automatic follow-up and viewing bookings
audience: Real estate agents and agencies in Ghana and Nigeria, especially busy agents handling many leads (100+ a month) who lose deals to slow replies and forgotten follow-ups
goals: Grow followers among real estate agents, build trust by sharing real work in public, and get agents to DM for a free trial
call_to_action: Follow @kortexa and DM 'SYSTEM' for a free trial
offer: AI chatbot on the agency's website and social media that replies instantly, qualifies buyers, books viewings, follows up with leads and hands over to a human when needed
brand_statement: Real estate agents who want more of their leads to actually close should invest in properly engineered AI systems, not plug-and-play chatbots that assume the AI will figure it out on its own.
contrarian_belief: AI isn't smart on its own. It's only as good as the system and prompting built around it. The engineering behind it is what makes it work.
voice: Direct, practical, honest and down to earth. Talk to agents like a peer who understands their day. Plain English, short sentences, no hype.
content_pillars: Lead leaks: how slow replies, missed follow-ups and missed bookings cost agents commission
Ready-to-use messages: scripts agents can copy to handle client objections and win more clients
AI done right: why the system and prompting matter more than the AI tool
Building in public: what Kortexa is learning from real conversations with agents
content_rules: Proof over promises: never invent results, client names, numbers or case studies
Only use numbers and stories that appear in the content bank; otherwise speak in general terms
Built for one industry: always speak to real estate agents, never 'any business'
Examples should feel local to Ghana and Nigeria (Accra, Kumasi, Lagos, WhatsApp, Instagram DMs)
No generic AI hype or 'replace your team' claims
topics_to_avoid: Generic AI news unrelated to real estate
